passage:
metrics — 指标，衡量标准
These metrics offer a sense of control and clarity.

toxic — 有毒的，有害的
However, an overemphasis on measurable results can create a toxic culture.

qualitative — 定性的，质量的
A more balanced approach recognizes that quantitative data and qualitative experience together provide a fuller picture of organizational health.

quantitative — 定量的，数量的
A more balanced approach recognizes that quantitative data and qualitative experience together provide a fuller picture of organizational health.

transparency — 透明度
When leading indicators are tracked consistently, they can become a normal part of management discussions, reducing the shock of negative surprises and building a culture of transparency and trust.

proactive — 主动的，先发制人的
This proactive stance contrasts with the reactive blame game that often follows poor lagging results.

lagging — 滞后的
Another approach is to focus on leading indicators instead of lagging ones.

foster — 培养，促进
By monitoring leading indicators, companies can intervene early and foster a culture of continuous learning.
